doctrine: Accepted identity (brief section 5): Captain Michael's faction is a spectacular alternate-1870s steampunk frontier power with substantially more technology than any other faction -- steam power, mechanical automation, frontier practicality, industrial production, mobile logistics, experimental engineering and armed independence. It is created during play from a shipwreck survivor with no nation, settlement, army, civilian population, government workforce or industrial base, and the first base becomes the faction's first strategic core. It is intended to become influential and strong, not a novelty settlement. Its strategic doctrine as an RTS economy is not written: brief section 6 covers the four ordinary factions only. Prose; nothing branches on it.
recruitment_or_population_rules: Accepted (brief section 5, and brief section 20's Rejected list): new members are recruited people -- female recruits drawn from the island's existing factions and communities -- never population generated by a building timer. Player-faction buildings producing human soldiers or workers from timers is Rejected outright. S3 enforces that at load; this field is the authored note, not the rule. The founding method, exact starting location, first construction sequence and how the four principal women join are Open (brief sections 5.1 and 20), and S12 and S13 own what replaces this note.

notes: Accepted (brief section 5): the identity summarized in the doctrine note, and the recruitment constraint in recruitment_or_population_rules.
